# CMakeLists.txt for building SQLite from third_party

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)

file(READ ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION SQLITE_VERSION)
string(STRIP "${SQLITE_VERSION}" SQLITE_VERSION)
string(REPLACE "." ";" SQLITE_VERSION_PARTS "${SQLITE_VERSION}")
list(GET SQLITE_VERSION_PARTS 0 SQLITE_VERSION_MAJOR)
list(GET SQLITE_VERSION_PARTS 1 SQLITE_VERSION_MINOR)
list(GET SQLITE_VERSION_PARTS 2 SQLITE_VERSION_PATCH)
math(EXPR SQLITE_VERSION_NUMBER
    "${SQLITE_VERSION_MAJOR} * 1000000 + ${SQLITE_VERSION_MINOR} * 1000 + ${SQLITE_VERSION_PATCH}")
file(READ ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/manifest.uuid SQLITE_SOURCE_ID)
string(STRIP "${SQLITE_SOURCE_ID}" SQLITE_SOURCE_ID)

file(READ ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/sqlite.h.in SQLITE_HEADER)
string(REPLACE "--VERS--" "${SQLITE_VERSION}" SQLITE_HEADER "${SQLITE_HEADER}")
string(REPLACE "--VERSION-NUMBER--" "${SQLITE_VERSION_NUMBER}" SQLITE_HEADER "${SQLITE_HEADER}")
string(REPLACE "--SOURCE-ID--" "${SQLITE_SOURCE_ID}" SQLITE_HEADER "${SQLITE_HEADER}")
string(REPLACE "--SCM-BRANCH--" "cortext" SQLITE_HEADER "${SQLITE_HEADER}")
string(REPLACE "--SCM-TAGS--" "" SQLITE_HEADER "${SQLITE_HEADER}")
string(REPLACE "--SCM-DATETIME--" "" SQLITE_HEADER "${SQLITE_HEADER}")
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sqlite3.h
    "${SQLITE_HEADER}\n#endif /* SQLITE3_H */\n")

add_executable(sqlite_lemon tool/lemon.c)
add_executable(sqlite_mkkeywordhash tool/mkkeywordhash.c)
if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    target_link_options(sqlite_lemon PRIVATE "-sNODERAWFS=1")
endif()
set(SQLITE_MKKEYWORDHASH_COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:sqlite_mkkeywordhash>)
if(EMSCRIPTEN)
    if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR)
        set(SQLITE_MKKEYWORDHASH_COMMAND
            ${CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR}
            $<TARGET_FILE:sqlite_mkkeywordhash>
        )
    elseif(DEFINED ENV{EMSDK_NODE})
        set(SQLITE_MKKEYWORDHASH_COMMAND
            $ENV{EMSDK_NODE}
            $<TARGET_FILE:sqlite_mkkeywordhash>
        )
    else()
        find_program(SQLITE_NODE_EXECUTABLE NAMES node)
        if(NOT SQLITE_NODE_EXECUTABLE)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Node.js is required to run SQLite generator tools under Emscripten")
        endif()
        set(SQLITE_MKKEYWORDHASH_COMMAND
            ${SQLITE_NODE_EXECUTABLE}
            $<TARGET_FILE:sqlite_mkkeywordhash>
        )
    endif()
endif()
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.h
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/parse.y
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.y
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/lempar.c
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lempar.c
    COMMAND sqlite_lemon -Tlempar.c parse.y
    DEPENDS
        sqlite_lemon
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/lempar.c
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/parse.y
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opcodes.h
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkopcodeh.py
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.h
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/vdbe.c
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opcodes.h
    DEPENDS
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkopcodeh.py
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.h
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/vdbe.c
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pragma.h
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkpragmatab.py
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pragma.h
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkpragmatab.tcl
    DEPENDS
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkpragmatab.py
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/mkpragmatab.tcl
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/keywordhash.h
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/run_to_file.py
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/keywordhash.h
            ${SQLITE_MKKEYWORDHASH_COMMAND}
    DEPENDS
        sqlite_mkkeywordhash
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool/run_to_file.py
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(sqlite_generated_headers
    DEPENDS
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.h
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opcodes.h
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pragma.h
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/keywordhash.h
)

file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ctime.c
    "/* Generated by cortext CMake fallback when tclsh is unavailable. */\n"
    "#ifndef SQLITE_OMIT_COMPILEOPTION_DIAGS\n"
    "const char **sqlite3CompileOptions(int *pnOpt){\n"
    "  static const char *azCompileOpt[] = { 0 };\n"
    "  if( pnOpt ) *pnOpt = 0;\n"
    "  return azCompileOpt;\n"
    "}\n"
    "#endif\n"
)
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opcodes.c
    "/* Generated by cortext CMake fallback when tclsh is unavailable. */\n"
    "#if !defined(SQLITE_OMIT_EXPLAIN) || defined(SQLITE_ENABLE_BYTECODE_VTAB)\n"
    "const char *sqlite3OpcodeName(int i){\n"
    "  (void)i;\n"
    "  return \"OP_Unknown\";\n"
    "}\n"
    "#endif\n"
)

# Collect all SQLite core source files
file(GLOB SQLITE_SOURCES "src/*.c")

# Remove test files and other non-core files
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/test[^/]*\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "shell\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "tclsqlite\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "fuzzcheck\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "mptest\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "ossshell\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "speedtest1\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "threadtest[0-9]*\\.c$")
list(FILTER SQLITE_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "wordcount\\.c$")
list(APPEND SQLITE_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/parse.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ctime.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/opcodes.c
)

# Create SQLite static library
add_library(sqlite3 STATIC ${SQLITE_SOURCES})
add_dependencies(sqlite3 sqlite_generated_headers)
set_target_properties(sqlite3 PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# SQLite is C code, but we'll let CMake figure out the linking

# Set include directories
target_include_directories(sqlite3
    PUBLIC
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}>
        $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src>
    INTERFACE
        $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

# SQLite compile definitions
target_compile_definitions(sqlite3 PRIVATE
    SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_JSON1
    SQLITE_ENABLE_MATH_FUNCTIONS
    SQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK=1
)
target_compile_definitions(sqlite3 PUBLIC SQLITE_ENABLE_PREUPDATE_HOOK=1)
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    target_link_libraries(sqlite3 PUBLIC m)
endif()

# Suppress warnings for third-party code
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(sqlite3 PRIVATE /W0)
else()
    target_compile_options(sqlite3 PRIVATE -w)
endif()

# Install headers
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sqlite3.h
    DESTINATION include
)
install(TARGETS sqlite3
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
)
